theorem map_readout_density {Ω E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace E] (P : Measure Ω)     (X : Ω → E) (hX : Measurable X) (w : E → ℝ≥0∞) (hw : Measurable w) :     (P.withDensity (fun ω => w (X ω))).map X = (P.map X).withDensity w := by   ext A hA   rw [Measure.map_apply hX hA,withDensity_apply _ (hX hA),withDensity_apply _ hA]   rw [← lintegral_indicator (hX hA),← lintegral_indicator hA,

theorem terminal_hasLaw_tilted (u : ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0) :     HasLaw (process T) (gaussianReal (u*(T : ℝ)) T) (tiltedLaw u T) := by   refine ⟨(measurable_process T).aemeasurable,?_⟩   change (sourceLaw.withDensity (fun ω => gaussianTiltWeight u T (process T ω))).map (process T) = _   rw [map_readout_density sourceLaw (process T) (measurable_process T) (gaussianTiltWeight u T)     (by unfold gaussianTiltWeight; fun_prop),(process_isPreBrownian.hasLaw_eval T).map_eq]

theorem shifted_terminal_hasLaw (u : ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0) :     HasLaw (fun ω => process T ω-u*(T : ℝ)) (gaussianReal 0 T) (tiltedLaw u T) := by   simpa only [sub_self] using gaussianReal_sub_const (terminal_hasLaw_tilted u T) (u*(T : ℝ))                                                                         theorem tilted_terminal_mean (u : ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0) :

theorem tilted_terminal_mean (u : ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0) :     (∫ ω, process T ω ∂tiltedLaw u T) = u*(T : ℝ) := by   have h := (terminal_hasLaw_tilted u T).integral_comp (f := id) (by fun_prop)   simpa only [Function.id_comp,id_eq,integral_id_gaussianReal] using h

theorem shifted_terminal_mean (u : ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0) :     (∫ ω, (process T ω-u*(T : ℝ)) ∂tiltedLaw u T) = 0 := by   have h := (shifted_terminal_hasLaw u T).integral_comp (f := id) (by fun_prop)   simpa only [Function.id_comp,id_eq,integral_id_gaussianReal] using h  theorem shifted_terminal_second_moment (u : ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0) :

theorem shifted_terminal_second_moment (u : ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0) :     (∫ ω, (process T ω-u*(T : ℝ))^2 ∂tiltedLaw u T) = (T : ℝ) := by   have h := variance_id_gaussianReal (μ := 0) (v := T)   rw [variance_eq_integral measurable_id.aemeasurable] at h   have hs := (shifted_terminal_hasLaw u T).integral_comp (f := fun x => x^2) (by fun_prop)   exact hs.trans (by simpa only [id_eq,integral_id_gaussianReal,sub_zero] using h)

theorem constant_terminal_integral_shift (u : ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0) (ω : ℝ≥0 → ℝ) :     u*process T ω = u*(process T ω-u*(T : ℝ))+u^2*(T : ℝ) := by ring                                                                                                                                theorem tiltedLaw_zero (u : ℝ) : tiltedLaw u 0 = sourceLaw := by

theorem tiltedLaw_zero (u : ℝ) : tiltedLaw u 0 = sourceLaw := by   have he : (fun ω => ENNReal.ofReal (exponentialProcess u 0 ω)) =ᵐ[sourceLaw] (1 : (ℝ≥0 → ℝ) → ℝ≥0∞) := by     filter_upwards [process_zero] with ω hω     change ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (u*process 0 ω-u^2*(0 : ℝ)/2))=1     simp [hω]   rw [tiltedLaw,withDensity_congr_ae he,withDensity_one]

theorem tiltedLaw_zero_control (T : ℝ≥0) : tiltedLaw 0 T = sourceLaw := by   have he : (fun ω => ENNReal.ofReal (exponentialProcess 0 T ω)) = (1 : (ℝ≥0 → ℝ) → ℝ≥0∞) := by     funext ω     change ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (0*process T ω-0^2*(T : ℝ)/2))=1     simp   rw [tiltedLaw,he,withDensity_one]
